conversation_starters.title: 322 goats clock in for work at Centennial Airport
conversation_starters.summary: Centennial Airport, in Centennial, a suburb of Denver, 40 miles SE of Boulder, employed 322 goats to clear vegetation in hard-to-reach areas, reducing wildfire risk and discouraging wildlife near runways.
